review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The assessed package-update concern was optional, and no actionable defect in the six changed paths was established. The recorded x64 CI failure was an MWB LeasePublisherTests exception-type mismatch in a test unchanged at the PR base and head; that evidence does not establish a defect caused by these package updates.

**Validation scope:** The recorded ARM64 build/test jobs succeeded, but overall CI was not green because of the x64 failure. Its underlying cause remains unresolved; no independent complete product build or claim of infrastructure-only causality is made.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.

**Latest discussion revalidation:** The latest same-head maintainer review approves the update while noting that separate dependency commits normally improve bisection. Treat the commit-organization point as discussion, not a demonstrated package defect or a new required code correction. That approval does not retroactively turn the recorded unresolved x64 test failure into a clean CI result.
